title: Opening Baitza: Yom Tov for Hashem and for yourself
summary: The first shiur on Masechta Baitza: why the masechta is named for an egg, an egg laid on Yom Tov, and Rosh Hashanah as one long day. Then Rabbi Eliezer's lesson that Yom Tov is half for Hashem and half for yourself, and the teaching that a person's livelihood is set on Rosh Hashanah except for what he spends on Shabbos, Yom Tov and his children's Torah.
